name: HypeRate
description: Your real heart rate, live in Geometry Dash.

hyperate-id.name: HypeRate ID
hyperate-id.description: Your personal HypeRate ID. You can find it in the HypeRate app or on <cy>hyperate.io</c> (the last part of your overlay link).

connection-status.name: Status
connection-status.description: Live connection to HypeRate. A new ID is used as soon as you press <cy>Apply</c>.

demo-mode.name: Demo Mode
demo-mode.description: Simulates a heart rate so you can try the mod without a sensor.

hide-without-signal.name: Hide Without Signal
hide-without-signal.description: Hides the heart rate display while no heart rate comes in and shows it again automatically.

hud-edit-info.name: Position, size & opacity: pause menu > heart > Edit HUD
hud-edit-info.description: Drag the heart rate display anywhere on screen and change its size and opacity.

pulse-animation.name: Beating Heart
pulse-animation.description: The heart beats in sync with your real heart rate.

zone-colors.name: Zone Colors
zone-colors.description: Colors the display from calm (green) to panic (red).

auto-zones.name: Automatic Zones
auto-zones.description:
Everybody's heart is different. While you play, the mod learns your normal heart rate and sets the colors around it: <cg>green</c> is your usual, <cy>yellow</c> is getting tense and <cr>red</c> is well above your normal.

It needs about <cy>two minutes of playing</c> to get started and keeps adjusting over time. Turn it off to set your own limits instead.

zone-info.name: Your Zones
zone-info.description: What Automatic Zones has learned so far. Press Relearn to start over, for example after you changed your sensor.

heart-map-on-complete.name: Heart Map After Completing
heart-map-on-complete.description: Opens the Heart Map automatically when you complete a level - handy for a screenshot.

heat-strip.name: Heatmap on Progress Bar
heat-strip.description:
Colors a strip under the progress bar by your heart rate at each part of the level, so you can see where you get nervous.
Open the full <cy>Heart Map</c> with the heart button in the pause menu.

death-mode.name: Ice Cold Mode
death-mode.description:
You die when your heart rate reaches the limit. Stay calm!
<cy>Only makes the game harder - it never helps you.</c>

community-actions.name: HypeRate Discord
community-actions.description: Opens the HypeRate Discord invite in your browser.
